                                                FOREWORD

Quantitative Techniques, is one of the most interesting and scoring subjects of entrance examinations and has been
a part of most of the law entrance examinations since a long time. It contains questions testing the basics of topics
taught to a student up to Class X. It encompasses Data Interpretation questions based on concepts like Percentage,
Ratio and Proportion, Average etc.

CLAT and Other law entrance examinations have over the years varied their levels of difficulty in this Section. CLAT
2020, CLAT 2021 and CLAT 2022 were totally based on Chapter Specific Passages after the announcement made
by the Consortium. CLAT 2023 was lengthy and calculative and on a tougher side whereas QT in CLAT 2024 was
easier if we talk about QT in CLAT 2025 as well as in CLAT 2026 was of moderate difficulty level involving
calculations. To have a command over Quantitative Techniques, knowledge of the topic is necessary otherwise
there will be difficulty in solving the DI Sets. OLET has always asked mathematical questions on Concept and
Aptitude with Easy to Moderate level of Difficulties.
